notes.pe: exit P/E on next-year operating EPS (before interest), with cash added at face. Base 22, bull 26, bear 15: unchanged by the review, but the reason is restated. The first history (deep/multiple_history.py: median 23.9, last 24 months about 17) divided past prices by earnings reported later and is withdrawn. Own five-year forward P/E on what was known at each month-end (60 month-ends 11.2021-10.2026): on the company EPS guide in force, rolled 12 months, median 28.6, middle half 22.2-30.2, last 24 months 26.7 (deep/verify_guide_pe.py, 20 SEC exhibits 99.1); on the quarterly consensus as it stood before each report (Alpha Vantage, deep/review_consensus_pe.py) 24.6; consensus ran above the guide, so the centre is about 27 on total EPS = about 25.5 in this model's terms (22 here = 23.9x total EPS at the horizon, where cash is $84 a share). So 22 is about 3.5 turns under the locked rule, not 1.9. Stated facts for the departure: (1) the median was formed while the store count grew 11-15% a year and, in 2025-26, on guidance far below what was earned; at the horizon stores grow about 5.5% and sales 8%; (2) peers at this growth: Ollie's 19.1x, Dollar Tree 17.5x (Alpha Vantage consensus, 13.11.2026, not re-pulled); (3) the model's own cash flows support about 21x at the horizon; (4) the price today is 21.1x net of cash. Variant at the rule (25.5): see deep/review_answers.md. Bear 15 kept: on the guide in force the 7.2024-4.2025 trough was 13-19x, not 10-12x.
